in_marathi.name: Harbans
in_marathi.long_meaning: Harbans हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Harbans is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Har' meaning God and 'Bans' meaning bounty or riches. The name is believed to bestow the blessings of God upon the bearer.
